card.name: Skin-damage wording in topical steroid warnings
card.fires_on: Words just before a list of skin-barrier damage terms (atrophy, striae) in topical corticosteroid warnings, such as "may include", "skin" and "Cut|aneous". Also fires before words about a broken skin or eye surface.

modes.label: Lead-in to local reactions
modes.description: The word include or skin right before a list of local skin effects like atrophy and striae.
modes.example: Local adverse reactions with topical steroids may<< include>> atrophy, striae, irritation

modes.description: The middle of the word Cutaneous in the section heading on skin reactions.

card.writes: It seems to push toward the word barrier, as in a damaged skin barrier, and away from inline-type code words.
card.plain: It fires where a topical steroid label is about to name harm to the skin surface, such as thinning or stretch marks.
